# Angular router syntax cache

This fixture tests source capture only. Framework proof and routing graph facts
belong to T014d2. Imports from `other-router` intentionally pass the syntax
filter. Local factories and local `provideRouter` do not. `calls.ts` also keeps
block, parameter, loop and catch shadows explicit. Loader results are never run.

`arrays.ts` checks only previously uncached array forms; `ordinary` must remain
solely in declarations.Constants. The golden projects only the router payload.
Tests copy the fixture before writing CRLF input. No inert ignore-file mappings
are needed; the fixture contains no ignore files or ignored directory names.
